items.description:
##Today##

A few outbreaks of rain around at first, this clearing later in the morning as sunny intervals develop. Then a few showers developing, mainly this afternoon.


##Temperature##

##Rainfall (mm):##

1-3


##Wind Speed##

25

W


##Wind##

SW, quickly veering W, 20-25, increasing 25-35 with gusts 35-45 later.


##Visibility##

Good, falling moderate in rain or showers. Hill fog becoming isolated.


##Comments##

Strong winds. Risk of coastal overtopping around high tide in the west.
